Name: Maggs Non-Smoking Sebastian sprites and dialogue
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
Did you fall in love with our favorite emo nerd, only to be sadly disappointed when you discovered he smokes? This mod replaces Sebastian's smoking sprites with two options: a handheld game or a lollipop, like the goofy anime edits for kids :D

[b]Included in this mod[/b]
Sprite patches for:
[list]
[*]vanilla Sebastian
[*]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic: all seasons + fall fair
[/list]Dialogue replacement for smoking lines in vanilla and Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion
Edit to Sebastian's 10 heart vanilla event

If you find any other references to smoking that I missed, let me know and I'll add them! Also tell me if any sprite doesn't work in a particular situation.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218055.png[/img]﻿
Compatible with:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]
All of Magg's mods

Technically but not aesthetically compatible with other sprite mods, as long as they use the same filenames as the vanilla game. These sprites will patch the smoking ones so Seb will appear vanilla during smoking scenes.

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/30639090]Prismuth[/url] for the original handheld game idea.
